Elena Park: Hey team — we just merged and published the Community Model Attribution & Licensing Cards v1.0 standard. This is the canonical model card schema + attribution/license metadata we want community repos to include. https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-cards/releases/tag/v1.0 :party_parrot:
Samir Khanna: Nice! Is there a minimal YAML header we recommend for model metadata?
Elena Park: yes — see snippet below. It's intentionally tiny for quick adoption:
```
model_name: my-open-model
license: apache-2.0
weights_checksum: sha256:...
attribution:
  authors: ["Org / Person"]
```
Theo Ramos: How do we handle backwards compatibility with the old `README-MODEL.md`? Any migration script?
Elena Park: There's a small migrator script in the repo (`scripts/migrate_readme_to_card.py`) and we've added tests. We do plan to keep `README-MODEL.md` supported for a patch window (6 months).
Maya Chen: Happy to help with docs and translations — can we get a list of the required strings to localize?
Riya Singh: Can we add an optional contributor credit badge? I can prototype a small SVG generator.
doc-bot: PR #412 merged by @elena (model-cards: release v1.0) — changelog: schema stabilization, migrator, examples, badge guide.
